description: This file manages temporary file creation, cleanup, and lifecycle handling, including signal-safe cleanup and resource deallocation. It defines functions for creating, registering, opening, closing, renaming, and deleting temporary files with associated cleanup handlers.

classes.name: tempfile
classes.description: Represents a temporary file, maintaining its state, filename, file descriptor, open FILE pointer, owner PID, and associated directory if applicable.

methods.name: int remove_template_directory(struct tempfile * tempfile,int in_signal_handler)
methods.description: Removes the directory associated with a tempfile, handling signal context.

methods.name: void remove_tempfiles(int in_signal_handler)
methods.description: Removes all active tempfiles owned by the current process, invoked during cleanup.

methods.name: void remove_tempfiles_on_exit(void)
methods.description: Handler called at program exit to clean up tempfiles.

methods.name: void remove_tempfiles_on_signal(int signo)
methods.description: Signal handler for cleanup during signals, re-raises the signal after cleanup.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * new_tempfile(void)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new tempfile object.

methods.name: void activate_tempfile(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Adds the tempfile to the global list and sets its owner as current process.

methods.name: void deactivate_tempfile(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Removes the tempfile from the global list and releases its resources.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * create_tempfile_mode(const char * path,int mode)
methods.description: Creates a new temporary file with specific mode at the given path.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * register_tempfile(const char * path)
methods.description: Registers an existing file as a tempfile.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * mks_tempfile_sm(const char * filename_template,int suffixlen,int mode)
methods.description: Creates a tempfile based on a filename template and mode.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * mks_tempfile_tsm(const char * filename_template,int suffixlen,int mode)
methods.description: Creates a tempfile with a temporary directory and filename template.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * mks_tempfile_dt(const char * directory_template,const char * filename)
methods.description: Creates a directory-based tempfile with a specific filename.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * xmks_tempfile_m(const char * filename_template,int mode)
methods.description: Creates a tempfile with error handling and full path.

methods.name: FILE * fdopen_tempfile(struct tempfile * tempfile,const char * mode)
methods.description: Returns a FILE pointer for the tempfile, opening it if necessary.

methods.name: const char * get_tempfile_path(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Returns the filepath of the tempfile.

methods.name: int get_tempfile_fd(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor of the tempfile.

methods.name: FILE * get_tempfile_fp(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Returns the FILE pointer of the tempfile.

methods.name: int close_tempfile_gently(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Closes the tempfile, releasing resources, handling errors.

methods.name: int reopen_tempfile(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Reopens a closed tempfile for writing.

methods.name: int rename_tempfile(struct tempfile ** tempfile_p,const char * path)
methods.description: Renames a tempfile, closing it first.

methods.name: int delete_tempfile(struct tempfile ** tempfile_p)
methods.description: Deletes a tempfile, closing and unlinking it.

ctags.name: mks_tempfile_sm
ctags.pattern: /^struct tempfile *mks_tempfile_sm(const char *filename_template, int suffixlen, int mode)$/

ctags.name: mks_tempfile_tsm
ctags.pattern: /^struct tempfile *mks_tempfile_tsm(const char *filename_template, int suffixlen, int mode)$/
